main_theme.notes: Title/credits. Slow open-fifth bell motif over low strings, restrained build, one breath at ~64-72 s, ends on a bare fifth. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (96.000 s = 24 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

dominion_combat.notes: Heavy 4/4 battle cue. Sparse low hits for the first 20 s, then full taiko/low-brass ostinato that keeps building. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (91.200 s = 38 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

frozen_stealth.notes: Stealth bed. Sustained glassy partials + ticking pulse; a low boom every 2 bars (6 s). Dark: little content above 3 kHz. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (78.000 s = 26 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

relay_combat.notes: Fast precise action. 15 s lighter arpeggio intro, then steady staccato/electronic drive; very even level. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (86.250 s = 46 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

atrium_carrier.notes: 0-37 s stillness (sustained strings + clock ticks), 37-78 s emergency swell, 78-82 s decay, 82-92 s quiet coda that matches the intro. Loudness-levelled: use state gain for dynamics. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (90.005 s = 27 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

eclipse_combat.notes: Dread combat. Regular mechanical pulse; breakdown at ~63-72 s (ring-out, one bar of hits, ring-out) then slams back. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (87.267 s = 40 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

core_witness.notes: Awe/stillness. Four solo bell strikes, pad from ~19 s, full drone + bell every bar from ~35 s to the end. Loop: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (100.364 s = 23 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade and the seam is bar-aligned.

witness_elegy.key: D minor (ends on an unresolved low A/B-flat chord, then a lone high D bell)
witness_elegy.notes: Z10 witness: a memory of a last battle, watched, not played. Solemn low strings and a sustained high wordless-pad tone with one low accent per bar; from ~32 s the full ensemble with low drums and brass on every bar, building steadily to ~112 s (the drums do not recede in the last third; the build runs to the end). The last full chord (low A/B-flat, unresolved) strikes at 112 s and decays to 116 s; a lone high D bell strikes at 116 s and rings into the tail (faded over the last 1.2 s). Intended as a one-shot started with the scene. If the scene runs longer, the whole-file loop is bar-aligned: start the next pass at seconds-2.0 (116.000 s = 29 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade; each pass then breathes through the decay (about 1 s under -40 dB) before restarting. Two-pass linear loudnorm: the generated build is kept (opening about 8 dB under the body).

farewell_departure.key: F major (ends on an open F-C fifth)
farewell_departure.notes: Z12 farewell / departure. 0-15 s: a soft bell/celesta figure over low strings; 15 s: warm string pad enters; 30-72 s: the restrained swell (peak ~60-64 s); 72-94 s: settles back; 94-107 s: quiet hopeful coda (bells over held strings) and a soft fade in the last ~2 s. No drums. Opening lifted +10 dB and coda +8 dB before loudnorm so the arc survives a linear (two-pass) loudnorm: opening ~6 dB and coda ~10 dB under the swell. One-shot by intent; the whole-file loop is still bar-aligned: next pass at seconds-2.0 (107.077 s = 29 bars) with a 2.0 s equal-power crossfade, quiet into quiet.

wound_vista.key: D (low D drone, dissonant D/E-flat/A overtones)
wound_vista.notes: Z09 overlook, first view of the wound. A giant heartbeat (double thud, ~0.3 s apart) on beats 1 and 3 (every 2.4 s) from the first second to the end. 0-19 s: heartbeat and one cold mid drone only (very sparse); 19.2 s: slow low swells join; 38.4 s: the full texture, sub drone, glassy high swells every 2 bars (9.6 s) and metallic resonance. The first pass plays from 0 (the sparse reveal, about 5 dB under the body); every later pass starts at loopStart 38.4 s (8 bars): loop 38.4-86.4 s = 10 bars = 5 swell cycles, then the 2.0 s equal-power tail; heartbeat and swell phase continue across the seam. Loop region alone: meanDb -15.7, -15.7 LUFS. Very bass-heavy (about 69 % of the energy below 80 Hz), hence the positive gainDb. Peaks limited about 2 dB before a linear (two-pass) loudnorm.
